valhalla.purpose: Multi-modal routing (walking, cycling, driving) with elevation profiles and localized instructions; waypoint optimization; separately sampled route elevation for driving profiles
valhalla.dataSent: Route waypoint coordinates, travel mode, avoidance options (highways, ferry), unit preference, language. For separate elevation requests: route geometry coordinates, route length estimate, sampling interval, polyline encoding and precision; bicycle type, hill preference and quieter-road preference. For walking routes: the route geometry (to find its crosswalks) and points along it (to name the streets it follows and crosses)
valhalla.dataReceived: Trip with polyline6 geometry, localized turn-by-turn instructions, distance/duration, elevation profile, up to 3 alternatives. Optimized waypoint order. Separate elevation responses contain sampled heights and cumulative distances; they do not identify the underlying DEM. For walking routes: the type of each path segment (such as crosswalk) and the names of nearby streets.
